answer: Charge every agent a small refundable bond before it can trade. A fable about free, open identity sounds fair, but it lets one attacker wear a thousand faces at no cost. The bond changes that math. Each fake identity needs its own deposit, and any agent caught cheating loses it. Over time, honest trading stains an agent's record like pigment on ivory: a long clean history is visible at a glance, and no fresh fake can copy it overnight.
